fusions.name: Wheeling Harvest
fusions.desc: Sweeps a curved pass that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Your afflictions on them spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Final Cut
fusions.desc: Strikes a target at or below 25% health, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.8 times their remaining damage to a blow that deals 18 damage.

fusions.name: Reaped Vigour
fusions.desc: Restores 20 health to you. Its healing rises +8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +40%). It has a 12% chance to heal critically.

fusions.name: Harvest Rhythm
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 4 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
